plain_language: Each facility was seen on a single day, which may not reflect its usual state, especially for things like medicine stocks.
Logistics meant one region couldn't be reached, leaving one zone unrepresented; a similar region was substituted.
Figures come from the SRA database on DHIS2, collected by trained assessors, so they are only as good as that routine process.
The study shows which factors go together with quality, not that they cause it.
